description: Search the ORSF register of Slovak companies (~800k records). Full-text search over company name, IČO (company ID) and DIČ (tax ID), with structured filters. Returns a paginated list with basic company info. Use this first when the user mentions a company by name — get the IČO, then call get_company for full details.

establishedYearMax.description: Only companies established on or before this year.

establishedYearMin.description: Only companies established on or after this year.

isVatPayer.description: Filter by VAT payer status (true = registered DPH platiteľ).

legalForm.description: Filter by legal form code (e.g. "112" = s.r.o., "121" = a.s., "701" = združenie). Omit for all.

q.description: Free-text query — company name, IČO (8 digits) or DIČ (10 digits).

region.description: Filter by region (kraj) — e.g. "Bratislavský kraj", "Košický kraj". Case-insensitive partial match.

register.description: Filter by source register: "ORSR" (Obchodný register) or "ZRSR" (Živnostenský register).

name: search_companies
